publisher_source.title: The Oxford 3000 and Oxford 5000 by CEFR level (both inspected)

records.editorial_risk: Two distinct Oxford verb senses: physical decoration versus adding possibly untrue details to a story. Draft combines them; the example supports story embellishment. Specify the target sense, formal register and potential inaccuracy.
records.independent_reviewer_task: An independent HUMAN must verify exact-sense CEFR with attributable publisher evidence, English meaning, fluent Myanmar, original example grammar, British pronunciation and historical provenance, then provide a dated signed review. dictionary_sense_lead.sense_summary: Formal verb; Oxford distinguishes sense 1 decorative addition from sense 2 adding possibly untrue details to a story. Draft example is sense 2.
